reclassNote: Downgraded from Medium per severity-auditor (phlimbo-ea-04): shares M-01's root cause (L416 re-anchor) and identical 63.4% figure, zero attacker payoff, independent impact is dust tail-stall (~300 wei); folded into M-01 as the access-control/tail-stall angle. User-approved.
title: Permissionless collectReward (+ free non-staker claim() poke) re-anchors rewardPerSecond at gas-only cost, forcing worst-case decay / tail stall
description: collectReward is permissionless (L270) and, additionally, any non-staker can call claim(): _claimRewards returns early (amount==0) but _updatePool still runs and re-anchors rewardPerSecond (L416) - no tokens, stake, or approval needed. An attacker repeatedly forces _updatePool re-anchoring (via free claim() pokes or collectReward(1 wei)), driving M-01's exponential decay to its worst case: delivered = 1-(1-T/(N*D))^N, decreasing in N. Below the ~D/12 reward-wei threshold the per-update distribution floors to 0 and the remaining rewardBalance never distributes - the tail permanently stalls.
impact: Availability / value-delivery degradation of the reward stream. A griefer drives reward delivery toward the worst-case decay curve and can permanently stall the tail at gas-only cost. Attacker profit is ZERO (pure value-denial); the stalled tail is recoverable only by owner emergencyTransfer. No theft, principal untouched.
attackPath: 1. Attacker calls claim() as a NON-staker: _claimRewards returns early (amount==0) but _updatePool still runs and re-anchors rewardPerSecond (L416). No tokens or approval needed.
2. (Or) attacker calls collectReward(1 wei) - permissionless (L270) - to the same effect plus a forced rate recompute (L283).
3. Repeat each block to maximize re-anchoring frequency, pushing delivery toward the decreasing-in-N worst case delivered = 1-(1-T/(N*D))^N.
4. Below the ~D/12 reward-wei threshold the per-update distribution floors to 0 and the tail permanently stalls.
recommendation: Gate collectReward to authorized funders (or make the rate-recompute idempotent so repeated calls cannot re-anchor). Fix the root re-anchoring (see M-01) so a poke cannot reset the depletion window. Make _updatePool a no-op for callers that do not change totalStaked, and/or skip rate recompute when nothing is funded.
